help.title: 🤖 Bimgus — Clash of Clans Discord Assistant
help.body:
Hi! I am **Bimgus**, your automated Clash of Clans assistant. I track your accounts, keep you ready for Clan Wars, and deliver personalized insights across all your linked accounts!

Here are all available slash commands:
help.footer: Type / in any channel or DM Bimgus directly!

groups.name: 🔗 `/link [tag] [dms]`
groups.text: Link a Clash of Clans account to your Discord profile. All linked accounts have equal status!

groups.name: 🔔 `/dms [on|off] [account]`
groups.text: Turn Bimgus DMs on or off for all your accounts, or just one.

groups.name: 🗑️ `/unlink [tag]`
groups.text: Unlink an account from your Discord profile.

groups.name: 👥 `/accounts`
groups.text: View all of your linked Clash of Clans accounts (all accounts have equal status).

groups.name: 🏰 `/status [account]`
groups.text: Running timers and what is left to upgrade, in one message with menus to pick the account, village and area.

groups.name: 🛡️ `/defenses [account]`
groups.text: Check defense max caps, gear-ups, and Hall upgrade status for your Town Hall / Builder Hall.

groups.name: {crown} `/heroes [account] [village]`
groups.text: Check your hero levels against max limits (sends a report for each linked account).

groups.name: 🧪 `/spells [account]`
groups.text: Check spell laboratory research remaining to max your current Town Hall.

groups.name: ⚔️ `/troops [account] [village]`
groups.text: Check troop research upgrades remaining to max your current Town Hall / Builder Hall.

groups.name: 🔨 `/sixth-builder [account]`
groups.text: Check your real-time checklist and progress towards unlocking B.O.B (sends a report for each linked account).

groups.name: 📥 `/import-village [file] [json_text] [account]`
groups.text: Import your in-game village JSON export to track exact building levels, timers and costs. One export per account; it includes both villages.

groups.name: 🔥 `/roast [user]`
groups.text: Tag another member to let Bimgus deliver a witty, personalized Clash of Clans roast in the channel!

import.instructions:
⚠️ **Please provide your village JSON export!**

• **One export per account; it includes both your Home Village and Builder Base.**
• Attach up to 6 `.json` files at once if you have several accounts, or paste one export into the `json_text` option.

📖 **How to export from Clash of Clans:**
1. Open Clash of Clans ➔ Tap **Settings** ⚙️
2. Tap **More Settings**
3. Scroll to the bottom to **Data Export**
4. Tap **Copy** next to *"Export village data in JSON format"*
